title: Principles of Epidemiology: A Primer
description: Principles of Epidemiology: A Primer is an open-access, introductory textbook crafted for students and professionals in public health and allied health fields. The textbook is designed to provide an overview of the basic principles of epidemiology, providing a brief historical overview, summarizing tools, processes and principles of epidemiology and their contribution to public health.
authors: Christy N Bazan - Author / Pedro Curi Hallal - Author / Rachel A Hoopsick - Author / Sheena Martenies - Author / Andiara Schwingel - Author
